engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2289 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00489-V003: approve partnerdiag package/version/hash/license/runbook and board/SKU/revision compatibility with `spec_cx8aas_board_partner_mfg.json`; define required virtual-ID coverage and any prohibited/approved filters, privileges/dependencies/timeout/health aborts, complete output/artifact/exit schema; reconcile Procedure's RETEST with Criteria's PASS/FAIL-only text and approve RETEST correction/rerun as a separate action.

review_improvement: Preserves the exact full manufacturing command while making coverage, evidence and the omitted RETEST state auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Partner diagnostics are meaningful only when the JSON spec matches the board revision and all intended virtual tests actually execute. The tool's filter options can produce a superficially successful partial run, and a tail view can hide skipped tests or the initiating error. Since Procedure recognizes RETEST but Criteria do not, the reviewer cannot treat it as PASS or FAIL. Package/spec hashes, full coverage enumeration, lossless results and an explicit RETEST disposition are required.
